summary:
From January to March you wrote about the quiet of retirement since July and about life after your cardiac event: rehab sessions, walks, check-ups that went well, and some four a.m. nights. You wrote about Abena, calls with Emmanuel and Diana, friendships from the rehab group and with Kofi, the retired GP, and cooking dishes from home. In the garden you watched the daffodils come up, built a raised bed, and saw radishes and garden egg seedlings sprout. Faith became "more of a question than an answer," and you returned to hospital memories, including Colin.

You applied to an NHS mentoring programme. In January you wrote that you filled in the form and were invited to a call on 4 February. Later entries describe ringing the volunteering line on 20 March and posting forms on 31 March, now waiting for a call. No role has started yet. In March you wrote that you felt "settled."
